rawContent: JUSTICE FOR #DaunteWright. HM🔟 thoughts, prayers, condolence with the Wright family, and those who knew Daunte Wright. We must remain nonviolent as people in the quest for justice for Daunte Wright, the quest for freedom & justice for those we lost. #SayHisName #BlackLivesMatter

BREAKING: The officer who resigned that killed #DaunteWright is now charged with 2nd Degree Manslaughter. Prior to this charge, sources have identified Kim Potter as the officer who killed Daunte Wright during a traffic stop in #BrooklynCenter, Minnesota. #BlackLivesMatter
